Ancient Greek ( Ἑλληνική , Hellēnikḗ [hellɛːnikɛ́ː] ) [ 1 ] includes the forms of the Greek language used in ancient Greece and the ancient world from around 1500 BC to 300 BC. It is often roughly divided into the following periods: Mycenaean Greek ( c. 1400 – c. 1200 BC ), Dark Ages ( c. 1200 – c. 800 BC ), the Archaic or Homeric period ( c. 800 – c. 500 BC ), and the Classical period ( c. 500 – c. 300 BC ). [ 2 ]
